question.problem: What is the sum of the series $1-\frac{e}{4}+\frac{{e}^{2}}{16}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{e}^{n}}{{4}^{n}}+⋯\,?$
question.worked_solution:
The first thing we notice is that we can rewrite the terms of the series as powers of $\frac{e}{4}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}1-\frac{e}{4}+\frac{{e}^{2}}{16}-⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{e}^{n}}{{4}^{n}}+⋯ & =1-\frac{e}{4}+\frac{{e}^{2}}{{4}^{2}}+⋯+(-1)^{n}\frac{{e}^{n}}{{4}^{n}}+⋯ \\  & =1-\frac{e}{4}+{(\frac{e}{4})}^{2}+⋯+(-1)^{n}{(\frac{e}{4})}^{n}+⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we recognize that the series looks similar to the Maclaurin expansion for $f(x)=\frac{1}{1+x}.$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{1+x} & =1-x+{x}^{2}-{x}^{3}+⋯+(-1)^{n}{x}^{n}+⋯\,\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $x=\frac{e}{4}$ into our Maclaurin expansion gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{(1+\frac{e}{4})} & =1-\frac{e}{4}+{(\frac{e}{4})}^{2}-{(\frac{e}{4})}^{3}+⋯+(-1)^{n}{(\frac{e}{4})}^{n}+⋯ \\ \frac{4}{4+e} & =1-\frac{e}{4}+\frac{{e}^{2}}{16}-\frac{{e}^{3}}{64}+⋯+\frac{(-1)^{n}{e}^{n}}{{4}^{n}}+⋯\,.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the sum of the series is $\frac{4}{4+e}.$
